floorPlans.label: Emaar Equiterra floor plans via Madena
floorPlans.introduction: Compare three- and four-bedroom townhouses in Styles B and C. Each sheet shows both storeys and highlights the row positions for that layout.
floorPlans.note: Published totals include suite, garage and balcony or terrace areas. The Style B TH05 sheet prints 2,171.42 sq ft, while its components sum to 2,171.40 sq ft. Two Style B layouts show the same square-foot total with different metric totals. Confirm the figures on the signed unit drawing. A verified five-bedroom sheet was unavailable.

plans.label: 3 bedrooms · Style B · TH05
plans.area: 2,171.42 sq ft total area · printed total
plans.areaCalculation: 1557.10 + 354.03 + 260.27 = 2171.40 sq ft. Printed total 2171.42 sq ft. Source difference 0.02 sq ft retained.

review.images: Official Equiterra page supplied all five project renders. The panoramic equestrian path leads the gallery, the poolside townhouse view is on the card, and dining and bedroom renders appear in the interiors section.
review.location: Reviewed the official page pin, regional diagram and exact Equiterra brochure cover and physical page 4. Four visually read travel estimates are scoped to Grand Polo. The legacy developer brochure URL served HTML. The matched original brochure is attributed to its Mitchell’s mirror.
review.floorPlans: Fresh original 15-page Emaar PDF from Madena matched cached bytes. Reviewed all pages, including both full levels, notices, row positions and area panels on sheets 3–10 and 12–15. Page 8 has a 0.02 sq ft component discrepancy. Pages 5 and 8 print 201.99 and 201.73 sq m respectively against the same 2,171.42 sq ft total. Printed figures and all row variants retained.

unavailable: Five-bedroom Equiterra sheets and area range remain unverified. The Projectory listing reports Style E and F figures matching neighbouring Equestra, without a verified Equiterra-branded sheet.
Signed unit dimensions, confirmed plot access and entitlement to shared amenities remain unit-specific.
